## Purpose

Describe the standard, schema, template, or workflow being changed.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Backward-compatible
- [ ] Requires project migration
- [ ] Major-version change

## Validation

- [ ] JSON examples parse
- [ ] Schemas agree with templates
- [ ] Shell scripts pass `bash -n`
- [ ] Documentation links and paths are correct
- [ ] `VERSION` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when required

## Impact on registered projects

Describe whether existing projects need to upgrade their local files or standard lock.
